name: Jinyunpelta
isnote: Described as the most basal ankylosaurine (Zheng et al. 2018); placed in Ankylosauridae.
sum: Jinyunpelta is a basal ankylosaurine from the Liangtoutang Formation of Zhejiang, China, known from a partial skeleton with a complete skull.
holotype: ZMNH M8960, a partial skeleton with a complete skull lacking most of the hindlimbs — Liangtoutang Formation, Jinyun County, Zhejiang.
material: Five ankylosaurian skeletons were uncovered in 2013; a second specimen lay two to three metres from the holotype.
biology: Dental microwear has been studied (Kubo et al., cited in the revision).
author: Zheng et al. 2018
